description: Flask is a small Python web framework. It connects URL routes to Python functions. These 12 starter lessons use small examples and simple words. Read the result, make one small change, and try the practice question. In a practice folder create a virtual environment and install Flask with python -m pip install flask. Save one example as app.py and run python app.py. Use http://127.0.0.1:8000.
versionNote: Examples use Flask 3 and Python 3.10 or later.
whatYouWillLearn: Check a path number with Flask
Report a missing item with Flask
Run a shared check with Flask
learningObjectives: Read a query value with Flask
Add a response header with Flask
